summary.title: Summary
sentences: We mapped Monthly cost review in Finance (Finance): 5 steps, about 1 a month, 5 working days each time today.

AI fit: partial. Steps 1 and 5 (144 of 342 hours a year) read documents or text that vary in layout or wording and write or summarise text. Step 2: AI can assist, a person decides. Steps 3 and 4 follow fixed rules: a script or rules would do it.
Start with step 2 "Consolidate into the master file" (about 96 h a year) using Custom AI app or agent built by the AI engineering team (placeholder). Fix first: step 1 "Collect site spreadsheets".
Either can work: The AI would need to reach the SAP S/4HANA through a connector.
The expert's target is 2 working days instead of 5 working days.
About 342 hours a year go into this process today: a moderate process.
Before starting: Standard: Agree one way of working (one template) across teams and regions. What differs today: "each site sends its own spreadsheet layout".

feasibility.title: AI readiness and feasibility

questions.question: Is this a good AI use case?
questions.why: Steps 1 and 5 (144 of 342 hours a year) read documents or text that vary in layout or wording and write or summarise text. Step 2: AI can assist, a person decides. Steps 3 and 4 follow fixed rules: a script or rules would do it. Reading site files and drafting the commentary suit AI.
questions.quote: I write the commentary from scratch every month

questions.question: A dedicated AI solution, or a general assistant?
questions.why: The AI would need to reach the SAP S/4HANA through a connector. The files come from many sites into SAP.

questions.question: Is it worth it?
questions.why: About 342 hours a year go into this process (12 runs a year).

readiness.label: Defined
readiness.question: Clear trigger, result, owner, and a goal for every step?
readiness.reason: Trigger, end result and owner known; 5 of 5 steps have a goal.

readiness.label: Standard
readiness.question: Done the same way across teams and regions? Exceptions the minority?
readiness.reason: Teams do it differently: "each site sends its own spreadsheet layout".
readiness.toPrepare: Agree one way of working (one template) across teams and regions. What differs today: "each site sends its own spreadsheet layout".

readiness.label: Data
readiness.question: Are the inputs digital, structured or readable documents?

readiness.label: Systems
readiness.question: Are the systems known, with an export or an API?
readiness.reason: 2 of 3 systems have a known export or API (Outlook, SAP S/4HANA); not: Excel.
readiness.toPrepare: Confirm with IT how each system can be reached.

readiness.label: Rules
readiness.question: Are decisions fixed rules, or judgement that can be explained?
readiness.reason: 4 of 5 decisions are fixed rules or explainable.

readiness.label: Risk and size
readiness.question: Enough hours to be worth the effort? Sensitive data or regulation that needs a human check?
readiness.reason: About 342 hours a year and no sensitive data.

feasibility.readinessFooter: A guide to what would make the change easier. Not a verdict.
bullets: Standard: Agree one way of working (one template) across teams and regions. What differs today: "each site sends its own spreadsheet layout".
Step 5: pure judgement decisions; keep a person in charge.
